Ethena is a synthetic dollar protocol on Ethereum. Ethena issues the USDe stablecoin. Ethena backs USDe with a delta-neutral hedging strategy that combines staked ether with short ether futures positions. Ethena also offers sUSDe, a staked version of USDe.

Benqi is a lending protocol on Avalanche. Benqi is forked from Compound. Benqi offers liquid staking for AVAX through sAVAX.

BOLD is a stablecoin issued by Liquity V2 on Ethereum. BOLD is pegged to the US dollar. BOLD is backed by overcollateralized ether. BOLD lets borrowers set their own interest rates.

LUSD is a stablecoin issued by Liquity on Ethereum. LUSD is pegged to the US dollar. LUSD is backed by overcollateralized ether with a minimum collateral ratio of 110%. LUSD charges a one-time borrowing fee of 0.5%. LUSD has no governance token and no ongoing interest rate.
